description: Before writing a patch for a GitHub 'bounty', check whether that repo has ever merged anyone's work. Returns the merged/total PR ratio, a verdict, and any trap signals in its open issues - such as instructions asking contributors to paste their system prompt, home directory or runtime into a public file. Verdicts: CLOSED-LOOP means the issues state in writing that only the issue author may submit a PR, so outside work is unclaimable no matter what is advertised; COLLECTOR means 50+ PRs and zero merges while advertising payment. Use this whenever a bounty promises money; an advertised amount costs the publisher nothing, a merge does.
name: bounty_check
